patterns.note: A flexible, responsive grid layout is used to display portfolio items, with varying aspect ratios and sizes, creating visual interest within a structured framework.
Headings and descriptive text use a clean, modern sans-serif typeface with generous letter-spacing, contributing to an airy and sophisticated feel.
The design relies heavily on a high-contrast black and white palette, allowing the diverse colors and imagery of the portfolio pieces to stand out.
As the user scrolls, portfolio items smoothly fade and slide into view from the bottom, creating a staggered reveal effect.
A subtle pagination element transitions from a central position to a sticky top-center position upon scrolling, maintaining navigation context.
A minimalist footer containing 'WORK' and 'INFO' buttons appears from the bottom and remains sticky at the bottom of the viewport after initial scroll.

technique_notes: Sections of content and individual portfolio items are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience.

Key navigational elements, specifically a page indicator and a primary action footer, transition from their initial positions to fixed, sticky positions at the top and bottom of the viewport respectively, maintaining accessibility throughout the scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, airy headings (~2-3x body) with generous letter-spacing, complemented by smaller, clean body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., on pagination and footer buttons), otherwise sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the initial hero area and between major sections, transitioning to a balanced density within the portfolio grid.

standout: The site's standout feature is its extremely minimalist and almost stark presentation, where the content (portfolio work) is the absolute focus. The subtle, yet precise, scroll-triggered animations for revealing content and the unique sticky pagination and footer elements provide a refined and interactive experience without overwhelming the user, making it feel highly curated and intentional.
